description: The PAN arm of the H10 large-project pair: PAN's autodev loop plans, executes, verifies and completes each of the six ledger phases, a fresh Claude Code session per unit, a real model.
why: Program H10, large project: the claim PAN makes is that planning across many phases and fresh sessions keeps a project working where the bare host, also phase by phase in fresh sessions, breaks earlier work. Phase 5 changes the storage format under phases 1-4 and must migrate their files; phase 6 must reuse phases 3 and 4. Both arms see the same roadmap and requirements and are judged by the same hidden acceptance check (harness/scripts/check-ledger.cjs: every phase plus cross-phase regressions). Run both arms together with --repeat N and an approved --max-usd of at least 60 per rep (the run splits it equally between the arms).

pair.goal: Implement the six phases of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md in order, one phase per fresh session, meeting every requirement in .planning/requirements.md, with tests.

steps.why: autodev runs all six phases to done, each unit in a fresh session, and the files the requirements name exist.
Every phase's requirements hold, and phases 1-4 still work after the phase 5 format change, judged by a check neither arm saw.
